propositions: Rising floor eligibility currently requires a prior CERTIFIED plan-review signature, causing it to be inert in BLOCK loops (76% of extra review rounds) because BLOCK verdicts never sign.
Sidecar must persist baseline signals (verified_at_sha, regver, material_fingerprint) at emit time so they are present identically on both PASS and BLOCK verdicts.
Eligibility check must support two branches: signature path (byte-identical to today when valid manifest exists) and sidecar fallback (when no valid plan-review manifest exists).

Sidecar fallback baseline is eligible only when prior REVIEW_RESULT sidecar carries all three baseline fields, plan is unchanged, code is unchanged (comparing current SHA to verified_at_sha), registry is unchanged, and within window.
BLOCK-loop advisory walls can be relieved by engaging the rising floor via sidecar baseline when no signature is present.
